race.description: Newcastle Car And Truck Rental Cameron Hcp (G3)
race.comment: MR MILLER (12) is another from the Waller yard with the upside to go through his grades this time in. Undefeated in two sharp wins this campaign and has the figures to get the better off these. FULLY LIT (8) Epsom placegetter third up. Stalked the good tempo and gripped on late with the 59kg when fourth at Rosehill. Can cruise across from the wide gate and take a hand in the finish. I'MINTOWIN (9) was back from a lengthy break with a slashing first-up second at Rosehill. Worth noting his best form is second up and stays in the calculations. HELLSING (3) good miler resuming. Made excellent progress deep into the campaign last time in. Fitted with the two trials and comes to hand quickly.
